dimensions.name: Customer
dimensions.tracks: how far the venture has gone from believing there is a customer to winning and keeping customers repeatedly.

stages.test: The customer and the problem are the founders' own belief; nobody outside the team has been asked.
stages.descriptor: The customer and problem are the founders' own belief; nobody outside the team has been asked.

stages.test: Some potential customers have been spoken to, but what they said does not yet point one way.
stages.descriptor: Some potential customers have been spoken to, but what they said does not yet point one way.

stages.test: The team can name one specific customer group and state its problem in a sentence; interest so far is verbal.
stages.descriptor: The team names one specific customer group and states its problem in a sentence; interest is verbal only.

stages.test: Interviews with that group keep confirming the same problem, and a written offer to them exists.
stages.descriptor: Interviews with that group keep confirming the same problem, and a written offer to them exists.

stages.test: People from the target group have tried the concept or prototype, and their feedback has changed something.
stages.descriptor: People from the target group have tried the concept or prototype, and their feedback has changed something.

stages.test: A named customer has agreed in writing to a pilot or to buy, and both sides have agreed how success is measured.
stages.descriptor: A named customer has agreed in writing to pilot or buy, with success measures agreed by both sides.

stages.test: A customer has paid or a committed pilot is running, and the same route to a sale has worked more than once.
stages.descriptor: A customer has paid or a committed pilot is running, and the same sales route has worked more than once.

stages.test: Several customers are paying, upcoming sales can be forecast, and each new customer is onboarded the same way.
stages.descriptor: Several customers are paying, upcoming sales can be forecast, and each new customer is onboarded the same way.

stages.test: New customers arrive without the founders selling each deal, existing customers stay and buy more, and customers act as references.
stages.descriptor: Customers arrive without founders selling each deal, existing customers stay and buy more, and customers act as references.

dimensions.name: Product
dimensions.tracks: how far the product or technology has gone from an idea to something that runs reliably at commercial volume.

stages.test: The product is described but nothing has been built.
stages.descriptor: The product is described but nothing has been built.

stages.test: A written plan says what will be built first and how it will be tested.
stages.descriptor: A written plan says what will be built first and how it will be tested.

stages.test: A first build exists; it works inconsistently and has had little testing.
stages.descriptor: A first build exists; it works inconsistently and has had little testing.

stages.test: The core functions work in the team's own controlled tests, with measured results.
stages.descriptor: The core functions work in the team's own controlled tests, with measured results.

stages.test: The build has been changed because of test results, and repeat tests show it failing less often.
stages.descriptor: The build has been changed because of test results, and repeat tests show it failing less often.

stages.test: It has worked in conditions close to real use, outside the team's own bench or lab.
stages.descriptor: The product has worked in conditions close to real use, outside the team's own bench or lab.

stages.test: It has worked in the customer's real setting with real users.
stages.descriptor: The product has worked in the customer's real setting with real users.

stages.test: It performs consistently across several users or sites.
stages.descriptor: The product performs consistently across several users or sites.

stages.test: It runs at commercial volume, with support and maintenance in place.
stages.descriptor: The product runs at commercial volume, with support and maintenance in place.

dimensions.name: Business Model
dimensions.tracks: how far the venture has gone from not knowing who pays to a model that keeps working as it grows.

stages.test: The team cannot say who pays or why.
stages.descriptor: The team cannot say who pays or why.

stages.test: Who pays, for what, and how the money is collected is written down.
stages.descriptor: Who pays, for what, and how the money is collected is written down.

stages.test: Cost and price figures are written down, but they are the team's own estimates.
stages.descriptor: Cost and price figures are written down, but they are the team's own estimates.

stages.test: The price and model have been put to customers and adjusted from their response.
stages.descriptor: The price and model have been put to customers and adjusted from their response.

stages.test: Cost per unit and margin are calculated from real purchase or delivery figures, and the routes to market are chosen.
stages.descriptor: Unit cost and margin are calculated from real purchase or delivery figures, and routes to market are chosen.

stages.test: Customers have paid or committed at the stated price in a pilot or test sale, and a delivery plan is written.
stages.descriptor: Customers have paid or committed at the stated price in a pilot or test sale, with a written delivery plan.

stages.test: The same route to market has produced sales repeatedly, and at least one channel or partner is delivering.
stages.descriptor: The same route to market has produced sales repeatedly, and at least one channel or partner is delivering.

stages.test: Margin and delivery stay steady as volume rises, and a written plan for growth exists.
stages.descriptor: Margin and delivery stay steady as volume rises, and a written plan for growth exists.

stages.test: The model sustains growth and its key figures are reviewed on a fixed schedule.
stages.descriptor: The model sustains growth and its key figures are reviewed on a fixed schedule.

dimensions.name: Moat
dimensions.tracks: what the venture has that others cannot easily copy, and how well it is owned and protected. Covers patents, designs, trademarks, trade secrets, proprietary data, know-how, licences and regulatory approvals, and exclusive agreements.

stages.test: The team cannot say what is hard to copy, or who owns what has been created.
stages.descriptor: The team cannot say what is hard to copy, or who owns what has been created.

stages.test: The team has started checking what already exists: similar products, published work, existing rights.
stages.descriptor: The team has started checking what already exists: similar products, published work, existing rights.

stages.test: What is unique is written down, and ownership is settled between founders, institution and other contributors.
stages.descriptor: What is unique is written down, and ownership is settled between founders, institution and other contributors.

stages.test: For each asset, a route of protection has been chosen (register it, keep it secret, lock it in by contract) with reasons.
stages.descriptor: For each asset, a protection route has been chosen (register, keep secret, or contract) with reasons.

stages.test: Protection is being prepared with professional help, and records are kept in a standard way.
stages.descriptor: Protection is being prepared with professional help, and records are kept in a standard way.

stages.test: First formal protection is in place, and the risk of infringing others' rights has been reviewed.
stages.descriptor: First formal protection is in place, and the risk of infringing others' rights has been reviewed.

stages.test: Protection has been extended to the markets and assets that matter commercially, and is tied to the business plan.
stages.descriptor: Protection has been extended to the markets and assets that matter commercially, and is tied to the business plan.

stages.test: The position has held up, and licensing or partnership options built on it have been explored.
stages.descriptor: The position has held up, and licensing or partnership options built on it have been explored.

stages.test: The position is maintained and monitored, and it visibly earns business value.
stages.descriptor: The position is maintained and monitored, and it visibly earns business value.

dimensions.name: Team
dimensions.tracks: how far the venture has gone from one person to an organisation that runs without depending on its founders for every task.

stages.test: One founder, with key skills missing.
stages.descriptor: There is one founder, with key skills missing.

stages.test: Talks are under way with possible co-founders or first team members; roles are not agreed.
stages.descriptor: Talks are under way with possible co-founders or first team members; roles are not agreed.

stages.test: A core team is in place; roles are partly agreed and time commitment is uneven.
stages.descriptor: A core team is in place; roles are partly agreed and time commitment is uneven.

stages.test: Every role is written and owned, the team works to a regular rhythm, and the gaps that need advisers are named.
stages.descriptor: Every role is written and owned, the team works to a regular rhythm, and gaps needing advisers are named.

stages.test: Independent advisers are active, and there is a written hiring plan for the most pressing gap.
stages.descriptor: Independent advisers are active, and there is a written hiring plan for the most pressing gap.

stages.test: The team has kept to its rhythm over time, and decision rights and founder agreements are in place.
stages.descriptor: The team has kept to its rhythm over time, and decision rights and founder agreements are in place.

stages.test: All critical functions are covered by capable people, delivery is predictable, and there is structure beyond the founders.
stages.descriptor: All critical functions are covered by capable people, delivery is predictable, and structure exists beyond the founders.

stages.test: Hiring, onboarding and performance review run as systems, without founders handling each case.
stages.descriptor: Hiring, onboarding and performance review run as systems, without founders handling each case.

stages.test: A leadership team runs the company, and governance and culture hold as headcount grows.
stages.descriptor: A leadership team runs the company, and governance and culture hold as headcount grows.

dimensions.name: Capital
dimensions.tracks: how far the venture has gone from no view of its money to being able to choose between sources of capital.

stages.test: No view of how much money is needed or how long cash will last.
stages.descriptor: The team has no view of how much money is needed or how long cash will last.

stages.test: The team knows roughly what it needs and has a rough budget.
stages.descriptor: The team knows roughly what it needs and has a rough budget.

stages.test: A complete pitch and milestones exist, but the route to money is not decided.
stages.descriptor: A complete pitch and milestones exist, but the route to money is not decided.

stages.test: The pitch is backed by supporting data, and there is a plan naming whom to approach.
stages.descriptor: The pitch is backed by supporting data, and there is a plan naming whom to approach.

stages.test: Conversations with funders are live, and each milestone is tied to an amount.
stages.descriptor: Conversations with funders are live, and each milestone is tied to an amount.

stages.test: The venture could take money now: use of funds is clear and the documents a funder would ask for are ready.
stages.descriptor: The venture could take money now: use of funds is clear and funder documents are ready.

stages.test: Written commitments are in progress, and the runway is planned against them.
stages.descriptor: Written commitments are in progress, and the runway is planned against them.

stages.test: Money is in the bank or revenue reliably covers costs, with financial controls working.
stages.descriptor: Money is in the bank or revenue reliably covers costs, with financial controls working.

stages.test: The venture can choose between several sources of capital, with reliable forecasting and governance.
stages.descriptor: The venture can choose between several sources of capital, with reliable forecasting and governance.
